Wishing a speedy recovery to @POTUS Biden. 

Luckily he is fully vaccinated and has mild symptoms. But it’s important we remember that while we have made a lot of progress in combating COVID, it’s still out there and we should follow CDC guidelines.

Health Care Sharing Ministries use religion to prey on consumers in search of care, often leaving them without the coverage they desperately need. 

We must protect consumers from these dangerous and deceptive practices.

I’m thankful that @KHNews continues to shed light on the danger of health care sharing ministries. These scams use deceptive practices & endanger millions of patients. We must pass my Health Share Transparency Act to begin regulating these dangerous entities.

⚠️California folks: enrollment is now open for health insurance⚠️  
#GetCovered with affordable, reliable health care coverage ⬇️ https://t.co/4gCuJmkkmx

Today is the deadline for coverage starting December 1! 

Sign up today, and you can still qualify for a health plan that starts tomorrow. If you ever have high medical bills, you’ll only pay a small portion & your plan will pay the rest. Get covered 👇 https://t.co/fIavCsaQw4

This week, I was able to celebrate with the first class of veterans to graduate from Marin County’s Veteran Treatment Court program. As a country, we are still learning about the toll that military service places on service members and how to support them. https://t.co/gjsmcZl3Gx

With climate change accelerating, I am championing federal investments to ensure our water infrastructure is in good condition. 
I spoke with officials at the Santa Rosa Laguna Treatment Plant, which almost 300K Sonoma residents depend on, about improvements we need to get done. https://t.co/AkpiZ0jVLK

13 years ago, the #ACA became law. And thanks to this and investments like the American Rescue Plan and IRA, >35 million people have coverage.

The GOP is trying to slash these vital programs, but Democrats will keep putting #PeopleOverPolitics to protect affordable health care. https://t.co/roUOn3uLqT

Health Care Sharing Ministries prey on citizens in search of medical care, tricking them into purchasing inadequate coverage. As consumers begin shopping for healthcare during open enrollment, we need to ramp up our efforts to protect them from Health Shares’ predatory practices. https://t.co/Xsc4SMSzEZ

My Democratic colleagues and I made history by capping the price of insulin at $35 per month for seniors and lowering health care premiums and out-of-pocket costs. We're going to finish the job and bring down the cost of health care for everyone. https://t.co/ktaVcuA2Zx

My colleague and friend @RepWexton has shown immeasurable strength, courage, and resilience since her diagnosis.

We are standing with her in the fight to raise awareness and find a cure. #PSPAwarenessWeek

Thanks to the American Rescue Plan & the Inflation Reduction Act which I helped pass, eligibility & financial assistance for health insurance are more accessible than ever. Millions of people now have coverage. That’s #InvestingInAmerica.

Health Care Sharing Ministries' deceptive marketing tactics and overt appeals to religion keep leading people into inadequate medical coverage.

My bill would help protect consumers from these predatory practices and ensure consumers have access to clear, accurate information. https://t.co/xrel0S0F1h

A nonpartisan analysis now confirms that the Republican budget scheme will strip coverage and benefits from millions of Americans.
 
For months, Republicans have lied about their plans, but now we have answers.
 
And Democrats are using every tool at our disposal to stop it.
(2/3) This decision not only directly threatens access to essential, and often lifesaving, care – but it also sets a dangerous precedent that could impact Medicaid patients across the country.

In our district alone, Republicans’ disastrous bill will cut over 5000 jobs, rob food assistance from over 10,000 children, and increase health care premiums by over $3000 for those covered by the Affordable Care Act.

This bill is an undeniable betrayal of the American people.

Trump would rather shut down the government than give up his scheme to slash your health care.

@HouseDemocrats and I refuse to bend to a budget that doubles health care premiums, funds tax cuts for billionaires, and dismantles the government.

Your story matters.

It’s the reason we’re in this fight: to make sure that no one goes without quality, affordable health care because of Republicans’ greed.

Share your story here:
https://t.co/ILptaNSJ0V https://t.co/bMsxbKu4mf

The health care premium increases Republicans want to force down our throats will be catastrophic. In my district, we’ll see over 400% increases – and next door in Rep. LaMalfa’s district, we’ll see over 500%.

Republicans need to reverse course and help us save health care.

It’s week 3 of the Trump shutdown, and Republicans are still nowhere to be found.

I’m back in Washington with @housedemocrats, standing firm to reopen the government and save health care. https://t.co/P4q2QgAQD8

Every day, more Americans receive notices that their health care costs are about to skyrocket because of the crisis Republicans created.

Republicans chose to shut down the government instead of fixing this mess. They need to finally negotiate with us and end this chaos.

Republicans created a completely avoidable health care crisis to help out their billionaire donors – and people up and down the North Coast are going to pay the price. Here are some of their stories: https://t.co/DftjGZsKAv

We're on day 22 of the Republican shutdown – and it's officially the second-longest in American history.

House Democrats have been, and still are, ready to negotiate with Republicans to save health care and reopen the government.

Yet Republicans are off on vacation.

Millions of people are days away from losing their health care, and demolishing the White House to build a gilded ballroom is Trump’s main priority? 

They have no shame.
